Handle a GitHub Copilot Extension agent request. @param request - The parsed AgentRequest from the Copilot endpoint. @returns An async generator of response tokens (for SSE streaming). @example ```ts import { handleAgentRequest } from '@agentmesh/copilot-governance'; for await (const token of handleAgentRequest(parsedBody)) { res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify(token)}\n\n`); } ```

Extremely minimal YAML-to-object parser. Supports the strict subset used by governance policy files: - Simple key: value mappings - Nested mappings (indentation-based) - String, integer, boolean, and null scalars - Inline lists: [a, b, c] - Block lists: - item Does NOT support anchors, aliases, multi-document streams, or complex types. For production use, replace with a proper YAML library such as `js-yaml`.
